name: siemens_lasmo
description: Real 2-layer board exported from Siemens/Mentor (lasmo): both copper layers, both masks, both paste layers, a board outline, and BOTH a plated and a NON-plated drill file. No silkscreen layer.
source: yghdj/lasmo (MIT), via gerbonara tests/resources/siemens-2 (Mentor Gerber '.gdo' / Excellon '.ncd' output)
notes: First Mentor/Siemens board and first NPTH-bearing board in the corpus. Files renamed by function to conventional extensions (EtchLayerTop.gdo -> board.gtl, ThruHoleNonPlated.ncd -> board-NPTH.drl, ...); content byte-identical. Its non-plated drill layer ACTIVATES npth_to_copper_clearance (which is not_applicable on every prior corpus board) -- exercising that check on real artwork for the first time; it passes here. aperture_definition_errors also fails on this board, exercising the reason-string fix on real data. Having no silk layer, the silkscreen checks are not_applicable. Failing checks (aperture_definition_errors, min_annular_ring, layer_registration_margin, min_trace_spacing) are not individually ground-truthed, so the overall verdict is not pinned.
